user.description: Add your own fields to devices: a Matter setup code, a warranty date, notes, and any fields you define. Values are kept when a device is deleted, and re-attached when it's added again (for example after a factory reset).

abort.single_instance_allowed: SB Device Notes is already set up.

menu_options.add_to_device: Add a field to a device

add_to_device.title: Add a field to a device
add_to_device.description: The field appears on the device's page, ready to fill in. Clearing its value takes it off again.

add_field.title: Create a field
add_field.description: Scope decides which devices show the field: all devices, devices of the integrations you pick, or only devices you add it to. A device with a value always shows it.

edit_field_details.title: Edit {field}
edit_field_details.description: Renaming keeps every value and every entity ID. Text, long text and link convert into each other; other types can't change. Narrowing the scope never deletes values.

delete_field_confirm.title: Delete {field}?
delete_field_confirm.description: {count} device(s) have a value for {field}. Deleting the field deletes those values and their entities. Older Home Assistant backups still contain them.

options.picked: Only devices I add it to

unmatched_device.title: Are these {device}'s notes?
unmatched_device.description: {device} ({model}) has no notes, and {count} other {model} device(s) left notes: removed, or still in Home Assistant but unavailable. If {device} is one of them added again (for example after a factory reset), pick its notes.

pick.title: Notes for {device}
pick.description: {device} has no notes, and another device of the same model left some. If this is that device added again (for example after a factory reset), pick its notes. Next you can restore its old name, area and entity IDs.

data.restore: Restore name, area, entity IDs and entity settings (untick to keep the new ones)

error.blocked: Some entity IDs are still in use (see above). Everything else was restored. Delete the old device and submit again, or untick to finish without them.

abort.device_gone: The device is no longer in Home Assistant.

restore_identity.title: Make {device} {old} again?
restore_identity.description: The notes of {old} moved to {device}, a new device in Home Assistant (likely the same device added again after a factory reset). Restore the old name, area, entity IDs and entity settings onto it?

data.restore: Restore name, area, entity IDs and entity settings (untick to keep the new ones)

error.blocked: Some entity IDs are still in use (see above). Everything else was restored. Delete the old device and submit again, or untick to finish without them.

set.name: Set a field
set.description: Set a field on a device; an empty value clears it. A Matter setup code already stored elsewhere brings that device's notes along (it's the same physical device).

value.name: Value
value.description: Dates as YYYY-MM-DD; yes/no as true/false. Leave out to clear.

add_to_device.name: Add a field to a device
add_to_device.description: Show a field on a device without setting a value yet.

add_waiting.name: Add notes for an absent device
add_waiting.description: Store notes for a device that isn't in Home Assistant right now. They attach when it's added (by serial, or by entering its Matter setup code).

manufacturer.name: Manufacturer
manufacturer.description: As Home Assistant shows it; lets the repair prompt offer these notes.

model.name: Model
model.description: As Home Assistant shows it; lets the repair prompt offer these notes.

forget.name: Forget a device's notes
forget.description: Delete every value stored for a device, or for a waiting record (its record_id is in the summary sensors' rows).

record_id.name: Record
record_id.description: A record id from a summary sensor.

integrations.name: Integrations
integrations.description: Integration domains, for the integrations scope.

update_field.name: Edit a field
update_field.description: Rename a field, change its scope, or convert between text, long text and link.

name.name: New name
name.description: Values and entity IDs are kept.

integrations.name: Integrations
integrations.description: Integration domains, for the integrations scope.

delete_field.name: Delete a field
delete_field.description: Delete a field and all its values.

restore.name: Restore a re-added device
restore.description: Put the old device's name, area, entity IDs and entity settings on the device its notes moved to. Run it again after deleting the old device if some entity IDs were still in use.
